approval.scope: Local-only immutable Block 835 public-realm snapshot from exactly the three approved NYC OTI Planimetrics datasets; source-backed roadbed/sidewalk, estimated/source-constrained curbs, and estimated deterministic crosswalks at four adjacent intersections.

clip.rule: 14-member existing Block 835 building-union envelope buffered by 35 m geodesically at union mid-latitude; official features fetched with within_box and retained only when every coordinate is inside this envelope (no silent geometry repair).

providerIdentity: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI)
responseCrs: CRS84/WGS84 GeoJSON published by NYC Open Data; no Z coordinate is present in this API response
sourceNativeCrs: EPSG:2263 (NAD83 / New York Long Island US feet) per official Capture Rules
transformPolicy: Preserve source coordinates and Z exactly; CRS84 response coordinates use deterministic identity to EPSG:4326. A State Plane EPSG:2263 inverse transform is implemented in the normalizer for source-native inputs, but is not applied to this already-published CRS84 response.
